name: inverted-empty-guard
description: an `if <name>:` guard whose body returns early and whose next statement indexes <name>[0]: the guard is inverted, an empty value falls through to the index
applier:
def fix(line, o):
    m = re.match(r'^(\s*)if (\w+):\s*$', line)
    if not m: return line
    name, i = m.group(2), o.lineno
    after = [l for l in o.all_lines[i:i + 6] if l.strip()]
    if not after or not after[0].strip().startswith('return'): return line
    if not any(re.search(r'\b' + re.escape(name) + r'\[0\]', l) for l in after[1:]): return line
    return m.group(1) + 'if not ' + name + ':'
